TC-22/S23.title: Browser clock a day off: a task closed by Save & Extract is stamped with the device clock, and a day behind it vanishes from Finished Tasks
TC-22/S23.detail: Local stack on main 43c38a4f; every model call the page makes is answered in the page by ext-support.ts (an ai/* call it is not told about is failed, never forwarded) and the tripwire showed no model call. Spec ext-tc22-s23-clock.spec.ts (copy of tc22-clock.spec.ts with its own evidence), 4 runs. Clock +24 h: doneAt = device time, +1440 min from server time, both contexts. Clock −24 h: doneAt −1440 min, both contexts; after the list reload the Hospital task is removed and not under Finished Tasks (U13: completed tasks stay 16 h). Nursing Home −24 h is removed too (recorded only, Q12). Same as on e02167f; useEncounterTasks.ts / useSaveAndExtract.ts still stamp new Date(). Known: B18 (device clock instead of server time, UAT 3.8).
TC-22/S23.productIssue: On a device whose clock is a day behind, a task closed by Save & Extract disappears from Task Export > Finished Tasks at the next list load; a day ahead, it would stay ~40 h instead of 16 h (doneAt follows the device clock, UAT 3.8).
